messages:
Ethan Brooks: Hi all  starting as AE next week. Need help with: CRM seat, Dialpad number, Gong access, AE playbook edit perms, and the regional target list. Who do I ask?
Nina Kapoor: Welcome Ethan! Send me your work email and I'll spin up the CRM seat + add you to the regional list.
Ethan Brooks: ethan.brooks@redwood.ai. Would like edit on playbook to annotate call scripts.
Hannah Lee: Ill handle Gong + Dialpad. Dialpad tip: enable call whisper for recordings during shadowing.
Provisioning Bot: Ticket PRV-2478 created for CRM/Dialpad/Gong provisioning. ETA ~10 hours.
Nina Kapoor: CRM invite sent and added to "NE Enterprise" saved view. Linking AE collateral: https://drive.redwood.com/sales/ae-collateral
Ethan Brooks: Got CRM invite. Not seeing edit permission on the playbook yet.
Nina Kapoor: Fixed  you should have edit now. Also added you to #ae-shadow to join Liam's demos this week.
Hannah Lee: Gong invite sent. Sharing playlist: "AE-Ramp - Best Demos". Also uploaded a 2-minute voicemail script to the playbook.
Ethan Brooks: Perfect, thanks. One more  where do I grab demo credentials?
Nina Kapoor: Demo creds are in 1Password under Sales > Demos. I assigned the staging org to your CRM account.
Provisioning Bot: Update PRV-2478: All seats provisioned and permissions updated. Ticket closed. :white_check_mark:
Ethan Brooks: Appreciate it everyone. Ill DM if anything else comes up.
